title: ADB mDNS 异常自动恢复状态机

semantics.purpose: 供 AI 实现、审查和推导测试用例的结构化行为规范
semantics.events: 事件表示现有顺序执行代码中的阶段结果，不要求实现额外的事件总线
semantics.guards: 条件表达式使用 Python 风格伪代码，仅作规范数据，不交给 eval 执行
semantics.transition_selection: 按数组顺序选择首个匹配当前状态、事件和条件的转移
semantics.terminal_transition: finish=true 表示返回本轮结果，再执行 finalizer 选择常驻状态
semantics.scope: 一个 GUI 进程内复用控制器；多个 GUI 进程之间不共享锁或冷却

idle.description: 等待探测；本轮准入检查及最初的设备查询也在此状态完成

probing.description: 检查 ADB 能力及 ADB/系统 mDNS 可见性

confirming.description: 等待确认间隔，再查 ADB 服务并复查设备、取消条件

restarting.description: 执行当前 ADB Server 的 kill/start，停止预算 3 秒，启动独立等待最多 30 秒

verifying.description: 稳定等待后查询恢复结果

cooldown.description: 重启尝试后的保护期，不执行自动恢复探测

last_restart.description: 尝试开始时先标记，finally 更新为尝试结束时间，以保留完整冷却

guards.cooldown_active: last_restart is not None and now - last_restart < config.restart_cooldown_seconds
guards.interval_pending: last_probe is not None and now - last_probe < config.probe_interval_seconds
guards.stale_confirmed: system_supported and system_visible and not adb_before_visible and not adb_confirm_visible and not has_devices and not cancelled

actions.record_probe_and_read_devices: last_probe = monotonic_now(); read raw adb devices with 3s timeout
actions.probe: check server-status; query ADB TLS services; if empty and not cancelled, browse both system TLS types concurrently
actions.confirm: emit redacted progress; wait confirm_delay_seconds; check cancellation; query ADB TLS services again; if still empty, re-read raw devices and check cancellation
actions.restart: attempted = True; last_restart = monotonic_now(); emit redacted progress; kill-server(check=False, timeout=3); start-server(timeout=30); remain in restarting until startup returns successfully or fails
actions.verify: restarted = True; wait confirm_delay_seconds; check cancellation; query ADB TLS services and raw devices with 3s timeouts
actions.refresh_cooldown_after_attempt: if attempted: last_restart = monotonic_now(); state = cooldown
actions.release_lock: release controller lock acquired by this call

finalizer.applies_to: every call that acquired the controller lock, including early returns and errors

invariants.rule: Any raw device record, including offline, unauthorized or no permissions, forbids automatic restart.
Empty device/ADB lists alone are insufficient; require successful system discovery of a local ADB TLS service and two successful empty ADB observations.
Query failure, timeout and malformed output must never serve as empty-list evidence.
Automatic recovery must not call the manual restart path that stops competing servers on other ports.
A nonzero kill-server exit code does not prevent start-server; kill failure by exception/timeout ends this attempt. Cancellation is not checked between kill and start.

Queries and kill-server retain 3s timeouts; start-server uses its independent fixed 30s budget. Startup taking more than 3s within that budget must not be killed or treated as failed. Do not derive this budget from the GUI query timeout.
Only successful start-server completion sets restarted=true and enters verifying. Exceeding 30s returns restart_failed and leaves the attempt subject to cooldown; never immediately retry startup.
Mark last_restart before kill and refresh it in finally after the attempt ends. The full cooldown begins after completion/failure, never consumed by slow startup or verification.
Cancellation after successful start preserves restarted=true and last_restart.
A numeric instance suffix alone never triggers restart. Visible services produce advice rather than restart.
GUI polling/recovery, manual refresh and manual restart share adb_service_lock; control re-entry separately with a nonblocking controller lock.
Closing GUI or replacing its selected client cancels work at checked boundaries and prevents old poll results from being rendered.

Polling, refresh and restart capture Tk parameters on the main thread, resolve ADB in a worker, then publish via the main-thread queue only if parameters remain current and GUI is open. Concurrent results for identical settings reuse the first published client.
Recovery messages exclude raw instance names, GUIDs, full serials, passwords, pairing codes, QR payloads and Wi-Fi names.
Browse both TLS types concurrently under one deadline; terminate, escalate to kill when needed, reap processes and close pipes.
The final empty device check reduces but cannot eliminate external device-arrival races before kill-server.

gui_manual_recovery.state_representation: Logical sequential phases; runtime persists mdns_manual_restart_running for the whole operation rather than a second enum.
gui_manual_recovery.button_text: 重启 ADB 并重新检测

device_protection_notice.meaning: Automatic restart was skipped to protect USB/Wi-Fi sessions, including offline/unauthorized records; presence alone is not evidence of an mDNS fault.
device_protection_notice.update: Shared notice variable updates from device snapshots; log once on entry, do not repeat each poll.
device_protection_notice.when_disabled: Explain automatic recovery is disabled; keep the manual action available.

transitions.action: Explain interruption of current USB/Wi-Fi sessions and invalidation of the old QR; ask for confirmation.
No ADB command, QR cancellation or cooldown side effect.
Cancel old QR, increment session generation, cover QR, set busy and disable both action buttons and new pairing; resolve client asynchronously.
Wait for all captured unfinished QR worker completion events, including earlier QR generations, under one shared 30s deadline in the background.
Clear busy and re-enable buttons; no restart or cooldown.
Report unfinished QR task; no ADB command or cooldown; re-enable buttons.
Acquire adb_service_lock and recheck closing/client identity; restart only the selected client's server, even with device records. Stop/start budgets are 3/30s.
Set restarted=true; query raw devices then ADB mDNS services with 3s budgets.
Start full cooldown, report failure and re-enable buttons.
Start full cooldown, update device list and report device/service counts; suggest generating a new QR if needed.
Start full cooldown, preserve known snapshots and report restart succeeded but checking was incomplete.
Do not start restart after close/client change; let any in-flight kill/start finish, discard stale results and clear busy.

gui_manual_recovery.snapshots: devices/services=null means unknown; [] means a successful empty query. Never clear the device list based on an unknown snapshot.
gui_manual_recovery.result_feedback: Both wireless panel and QR dialog show progress and final outcomes, including restart failure versus incomplete redetection.
invariants: Only explicit confirmation authorizes a restart with device records; automatic recovery still skips all such records.
Repeated clicks while busy do not show another dialog or issue another command.
A modal QR dialog exposes the same notice/action as the main wireless panel.
All old QR commands across QR generations must finish before kill/start; old callbacks are rejected by session generation.
A new QR/pair/connect operation and automatic recovery must not start while manual recovery is busy.
The new manual action never stops competing ADB servers on other ports.
checked means redetection finished, not that QR pairing succeeded.

regression_cases.scenario: Real surrogate startup ACK arrives after 3.2s through AdbClient.run
31s startup with a configured 30s cooldown, whether successful, unverified or failed
